title: OpenCode LSP workstation setup harness
purpose: Give low-capability agents and Windows operators one deterministic path to recover a canonical checkout, recover the Windows-facing OpenCode runtime, inspect, configure, verify, and hand off OpenCode LSP enablement without changing product code, governance, secrets, or existing OpenCode configuration.

repositoryRecovery.bootstrapStaging: ephemeral OS temp directory removed after dispatch
boundedDiscovery: preferred path when explicitly supplied to the internal resolver
current directory as an untrusted candidate
repositoryRecovery.proofRule: The public operator bootstrap does not require a known local repository path and must work from an arbitrary current directory, including another Git repository. Its initial repository-content fetch is bounded by the documented operator command. Inside the bootstrap, remote Git resolution and exact-head resolver staging are bounded. The canonical remote default branch/head is resolved once, the checkout resolver is staged from that exact SHA, and the same immutable branch/SHA are passed directly as ExpectedBranch/ExpectedHead so checkout recovery never silently selects a second head. If the remote branch advances after that snapshot is selected, bootstrap-only resolver mode may continue only when the selected expected head remains an ancestor of the freshly fetched branch; a rewrite that makes the snapshot unreachable fails closed. The resulting worktree is still created at the original selected SHA. The resolved root is verified by canonical remote identity plus exact selected head and clean status, then Set-Location targets that verified root before bounded runtime dispatch. Only an exact canonical GitHub origin plus the selected branch/head snapshot may become the setup worktree; wrong or similarly named current directories are ignored and preserved.

runtimeRecovery.proofRule: OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND routes through the registered runtime recovery router. Recovery requires LOCALAPPDATA so the router and Inspect use the same canonical AgentSwitchboard shim/state root. Initial discovery is limited to the registered user-local locations and never accepts inherited PATH. The repair downloads the reviewed official installer from an immutable anomalyco/opencode commit, verifies its expected install-path and --no-modify-path contract before execution, and records that source commit in recovery evidence. The installer download target is a run-scoped host-injected literal /tmp path so Windows-to-WSL transport never depends on a Bash-local temp-path variable surviving argument serialization. The pinned installer receives SHELL=/bin/bash explicitly instead of depending on ambient shell state. Its process exit code and stdout/stderr presence are recorded as evidence, but an ordinary nonzero installer exit is not treated as terminal until the exact official path $HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode is independently classified. A healthy exact-path runtime may therefore advance after a nonzero installer postamble, while missing, non-executable, timeout, illegal-instruction, bus-error, segmentation-fault, and version-failure states remain typed failures. The bounded 30-second --version health probe includes a 10-second forced-kill deadline and persists no raw stderr. The independent exact-path version reproof is the final shim-creation health gate and overwrites typed health evidence on timeout/failure so receipts describe the actual terminal gate. A healthy exact path is then written to the canonical AgentSwitchboard shim and bounded Inspect is re-entered automatically.

upstreamContract.stableLspRule: LSP is disabled by default; lsp=true enables built-in servers whose file types and prerequisites are present.
upstreamContract.configPrecedenceRule: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is the highest runtime config source; the generated launcher preserves inherited inline values in memory and forces lsp=true there.
upstreamContract.interactiveModelRule: The current OpenCode TUI accepts --model/-m on the top-level opencode command.
upstreamContract.v2Boundary: Current OpenCode V2 documentation accepts LSP configuration but does not provide an LSP runtime; fail closed on a detected v2 command/version.

safety.proofCeiling: Static/hosted validation proves cwd-independent bootstrap routing, bounded single-resolution exact-default-head resolver staging, ancestry-guarded snapshot preservation across normal branch advances, canonical checkout/root verification, immutable installer provenance, installer-contract gating, host-injected installer-path transport, deterministic installer shell input, process-exit evidence capture, exact-path classification after nonzero installer exits, typed post-install health classification, forced timeout termination, final reproof evidence consistency, and setup logic. Checkout recovery can prove canonical repository acquisition and exact-head isolated worktree state. Runtime-recovery receipts can prove the bounded local discovery/version/install/shim/Inspect-handoff state without persisting raw OpenCode stderr, environment contents, or credentials. Workstation execution can prove OpenCode command/version resolution, immutable machine-local config artifacts, model visibility, and launcher generation. Active LSP diagnostics require opening a supported file and observing runtime behavior.
